title.official: Limitation on when judgment or noting in default may occur

division.heading: Actions Started by Statement of Claim

operative_text.controlling:
3.42   Despite anything in this Division, judgment may not be
entered against a defendant and a defendant may not be noted in
default if the defendant has filed an application that has not been
decided
(a) to set aside service of a statement of claim, or
(b) under rule 3.68 to set aside or amend a statement of claim,
to strike out a claim, or to stay an action, application or
proceeding.

BOOK_A.commentary_review_flag: Read in full, p.3-110 (lines 3090-3091): rule text (two pieces), Defined Terms 'claim, Court, defendant, file, judgment' (the Appendix defines each) and a two-sentence note; no Information Note and no Related Provisions. The built record: defined_terms holds the Defined Terms line, the two sentences and the heading of the next Subdivision and rule ('Subdivision 5 Claims Against Co-defendants', 'How to Make Claim Against Co-defendant'); related_provisions and commentary are empty; nothing dropped. (1) Note read against the official text and titles: 'If particulars are ordered, time to defend should be extended until that is done' is not in 3.42 (official 3.61 is 'Request for particulars'; 3.42 names only an application to set aside service or an application under rule 3.68); 'Paragraph (b) was applied to deny a finding of default' names no case. (2) The title printed for this rule is 'Limitation on When Judgment or Noting in Default May Occur' ('may'), the same as the official title; the labels for 3.42 in Book A's own 3.36 information note, 3.37 information note and R.12 note print '[Limitation on when judgment or noting in default can occur]' ('can' for 'may') - see the 3.36 and 3.37 flags; the R.3.42 related provisions elsewhere print '3.42 (no noting in default)'. (3) No history footnote for 3.42 is printed in this record (no marker after the text, no footnote before it); the footnote pieces at p.3-110 are 3.41's. (4) Other rules' pointers to 3.42: Book A p.3-95 fn 7 'R.3.42, confirming Sorochan v. St. Albert Protestant Sep. S.D. (M) 2001 ABQB 1063' (line 2617; in the 3.36 note) and R.9 p.9-43 (lines 2258, 2276) 'R.3.42; Sorochan ...' and 'R.3.42; Peavine Métis Settlement v. Primewest Enr. (M) 2005 ABQB 681' (both are named with the rule number only; cases not checked); p.3-161 (line 4765) 'Related Provisions 1.4(2)(h) (stays); 3.42 (no noting in default); 3.47-48 ...' (belongs to a rule not identified here); R.11 p.11-63 (line 3154) '3.42 (no noting in default ...' (cut off); R.12 p.12-76 (line 3616) 'and 3.42 [Limitation on when judgment or noting in default can occur] apply'; official text: no other rule cites 3.42 (cross-reference helper searched the official file).
